description: Groups the libraries the Android apps share, one pull request per library, so each app proposes its move of that library in a single change and the apps can be moved to one version together. It sets no schedule, label, automerge or version limit: the consumer's own settings decide those.

packageRules.description: DataStore: its artifacts share one version, and the apps should too.
Robolectric and its android-all jars. A bump moves the jar names a consumer passes to robolectric-cache.
